main_body: A bare, gnarled dead tree: a thick trunk with root flare at the bottom, branching into a leafless crown of dark brown limbs, with a few small moss patches and a knothole.
top_band: none (organic tree; no horizontal top surface. The scan down x=24 passes through branch and trunk tones with no light top band followed by a front face)
evidence: This is an organic tree, so no top-surface contract applies in the way it does for built objects. The trunk and branches are drawn as rounded volumes lit from the upper left, with highlight and shadow on the limbs and a knothole in the trunk. There is no flat or architectural elevation, no isometric side face, and no thin-rim cap. The kind is organic and the drawing matches it. Passes PART A as a plausible organic 3/4-view tree.
